dedupe_keys.name: ura data service private residential transactions rentals pipeline and planning decisions singapore

description: Singapore's Urban Redevelopment Authority publishes property market and planning data through a free data service for application developers, alongside statistics pages and a paid market database. The API gives private residential property transactions for the past five years (project, market segment, contract date, area, price, property type, tenure, floor range, type of sale, district and units), median rentals of private non-landed homes, rental contracts, units sold by developers, private residential projects in the pipeline, planning decisions and approved residential use, plus car park availability and rates. Update frequencies range from minutes for car parks to twice monthly and quarterly for property series. Coverage: Singapore's private residential market and planning decisions. Access: register for an account, receive an access key by email and generate a daily token; the REALIS database with project-level detail is a paid subscription. Licence: URA terms of use, not read. Caveats: public housing (HDB) resales are published separately, and transactions are grouped by project with floor ranges, not unit numbers. Simulation uses are property values and development pipeline inputs for exposure, capacity and investment appraisal models. Related records: HDB resale flat prices.
